title: Banking Act — Minimum Capital
provenance: Curated assessment summary; verify against official Kenya Law text.

title: Banking Act — Customer Confidentiality
provenance: Curated assessment summary; verify against official Kenya Law text.

title: Data Protection Act 2019 — Processing Principles
provenance: Curated assessment summary; verify against official Kenya Law text.

title: Data Protection Act 2019 — Impact Assessment
provenance: Curated assessment summary; verify against official Kenya Law text.
text: Where processing is likely to result in high risk to data subjects, the controller must carry out a data protection impact assessment before processing.

title: Data Protection Act 2019 — Data Subject Rights
provenance: Curated assessment summary; verify against official Kenya Law text.
text: A data subject may request access to personal data, correction of inaccurate data and deletion where retention is no longer necessary, subject to lawful exemptions.

title: Data Protection Act 2019 — Cross-Border Transfers
provenance: Curated assessment summary; verify against official Kenya Law text.
text: Personal data should not be transferred outside Kenya unless the required safeguards, consent or other lawful basis for transfer is satisfied.

title: Companies Act 2015 — Company Records
